description: Show this account: credits available, when they expire, credits held by briefs in progress, the limits that apply, how this client is connected (API key or OAuth), and whether it is read-only. Credits are prepaid units, not money; the result carries the credit terms (credits_notice, terms_url). Free.
name: get_account

auth_method.description: How this client is connected: an API key header, or OAuth sign-in.

credits_expire_at.description: When the credits expire (ISO 8601): 365 days after credits were last added. Adding credits extends it. Null when no date is recorded.

credits_notice.description: What a credit is: prepaid units, not money, with no cash value and no fees. Show it to the user when discussing credits.

credits_remaining.description: Credits available to spend: the balance minus credits held by briefs in progress.

key_prefix.description: The first characters of the API key; null for an OAuth connection.

scopes.description: What this connection may do: briefs:read, and briefs:write to request briefs.

terms_url.description: The Terms of Service that govern credits.

top_up_url.description: Where to buy more credits for this account, when self-serve purchases are on.

title: Get account
